[b]✦ The Expansion South: Gotlandia ✦[/b]
[i]"A new jewel upon the sea."[/i]

[b]WIELKA WARSZAWA ANNOUNCES HISTORIC EXPANSION[/b]  

In the fifth day of the Grand Duchys renewed prominence, the government of Wielka Warszawa has declared the annexation of a small but vital stretch of coastline to the south, henceforth to be known as [b]Gotlandia[/b]. This territory, long neglected by its neighbors, offers the Duchy an invaluable opening to the sea  a lifeline for trade, commerce, and naval security.  

The Grand Duke proclaimed:  
[i]"Gotlandia shall stand as the southern gate of Wielka Warszawa. From its shores, our merchants will sail to new markets, and our navy shall safeguard our prosperity."[/i]  

[b]FOUNDING OF VISBY'EGO[/b]  

On the near coast of Gotlandia, plans are already underway for the construction of a grand port city: [b]Visbyego[/b].  
Named in honor of an ancient, once-prosperous city, Visbyego is envisioned as a hub of trade, culture, and defense.  

[list]
[*]A [b]modern seaport[/b] capable of receiving large merchant fleets and naval squadrons.
[*]An [b]economic free zone[/b], lowering tariffs and encouraging international commerce.
[*]A [b]fortified citadel[/b], ensuring Gotlandias shores remain secure against foreign aggression.
[/list]

Construction began with a ceremonial ground-breaking, attended by ministers, nobles, and military officers. Local fishermen and traders were granted incentives to settle, with promises of markets, infrastructure, and protection.  

[b]STRATEGIC SIGNIFICANCE[/b]  

With Gotlandia and Visbyego under Warszawan stewardship, the Grand Duchy now possesses:  

- A direct [b]southern maritime outlet[/b] for its exports and imports.  
- A [b]naval base[/b] from which to project stability across the region.  
- A [b]symbol of unity and ambition[/b], embodying the Accords principle of prosperity through cooperation.  

[i]"Gotlandia belongs not merely to Warszawa, but to all who seek peace and prosperity through the sea."[/i]
